::: {#exr-gradient-noise}

#### How noisy is a minibatch gradient?

[lds's exercise on minibatches](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#exr-minibatch) shows that,
for minibatches drawn with replacement,
the minibatch [gradient](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient)'s variance is $1/b$ times that of one image's gradient,
for batch size $b$.
Take a fresh [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network) at its starting [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter),
and 200 minibatches each of sizes 8, 32 and 128.
Does $b$ times the mean squared distance between the minibatch gradient and the full-batch gradient
stay about the same?

:::
